title: Inside an SN2 Reaction
production_path_basis: The flagship showcase cycle requires explanations that work without narration or music.
assumed_knowledge: a reaction-coordinate diagram represents relative energy
central_message: SN2 substitution is one concerted backside passage in which bond formation, bond breaking, and stereochemical inversion describe the same event.
takeaway: Backside approach, two coordinated bond changes, one energy maximum, and stereochemical inversion are observations of the same event.
platform: website showcase, social portrait demo, and bundled desktop example
scientific_depth: introductory concerted mechanism, qualitative energy profile, and stereochemical inversion
visual_direction: dark cinematic portrait, persistent volumetric molecule, conventional atom identities, locked side-view chemistry, synchronized in-world energy panel
pacing: identity, alignment, concerted change, transition-state freeze, energy replay, inversion comparison, synthesis
constraints: do not depict a stable intermediate
do not imply bonds are mechanical springs
describe the shared progress state as project-local rather than a generic engine clock
success_criteria: forming and breaking partial bonds coexist in one transition state
the energy profile has one maximum and no intermediate well
a locked camera and reference plane distinguish inversion from rotation
all essential labels remain readable at normal phone size
